caption: A sunlit glass door swings open, and the shadow of its frame sweeps across the floor as it turns.

sa.check: The shadow of its frame sweeps across the floor as it turns.
The door moves first and the shadow follows.

pc.expect: The frame's shadow turns with the door and does not move before the door does.
pc.fail: It moves before the door; or stays still while the door swings; or swings the opposite way.

pc.expect: The frame casts a dark shadow and the panes cast little, and the shadow stays attached at the hinge side.
pc.fail: The panes cast solid dark shadow; or the shadow detaches from the hinge; or it is a different shape from the frame.

pc.expect: The shadow lies on the floor away from the sun.
pc.fail: It lies toward the sun; or on the ceiling; or it is missing in sunlight.

pc.expect: The door swings in an arc on its hinges.
pc.fail: It slides; or lifts; or spins.
A second door appears; or the shadow becomes solid; or the door passes through the frame.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The door and the floor stay the same, and the shadow stays dark.
pc.fail: The frame changes colour; or the shadow turns coloured; or the floor changes.
